lines.text: Wherein have I so deserved of you
lines.plainText: Wherein have I so deserved of you

lines.text: That you extol me thus?
lines.plainText: That you extol me thus

lines.text: Faith, my lord, I spoke it but according to the trick. If you will hang me for it, you may, but I had rather it would please you I might be whipped.
lines.plainText: Faith my lord I spoke it but according to the trick If you will hang me for it you may but I had rather it would please you I might be whipped

lines.text: Whipped first, sir, and hanged after.
lines.plainText: Whipped first sir and hanged after

lines.text: Proclaim it, Provost, round about the city,
lines.plainText: Proclaim it Provost round about the city

lines.text: If any woman wronged by this lewd fellow,
lines.plainText: If any woman wronged by this lewd fellow

lines.text: As I have heard him swear himself there's one
lines.plainText: As I have heard him swear himself there's one

lines.text: Whom he begot with child—let her appear,
lines.plainText: Whom he begot with childlet her appear

lines.text: And he shall marry her. The nuptial finished,
lines.plainText: And he shall marry her The nuptial finished

lines.text: Let him be whipped and hanged.
lines.plainText: Let him be whipped and hanged

lines.text: I beseech your Highness, do not marry me to a whore. Your highness said even now I made you a duke; good my lord, do not recompense me in making me a cuckold.
lines.plainText: I beseech your Highness do not marry me to a whore Your highness said even now I made you a duke good my lord do not recompense me in making me a cuckold

lines.text: Upon mine honour, thou shalt marry her.
lines.plainText: Upon mine honour thou shalt marry her

lines.text: Thy slanders I forgive, and therewithal
lines.plainText: Thy slanders I forgive and therewithal

lines.text: Remit thy other forfeits.—Take him to prison,
lines.plainText: Remit thy other forfeitsTake him to prison

lines.text: And see our pleasure herein executed.
lines.plainText: And see our pleasure herein executed

lines.text: Marrying a punk, my lord, is pressing to death, whipping, and hanging.
lines.plainText: Marrying a punk my lord is pressing to death whipping and hanging

lines.text: Slandering a prince deserves it.
lines.plainText: Slandering a prince deserves it
